# Training

*training.ipynb* is the file used to train the model

*history.json* logs the training results in the following shape:
[[avg train loss, avg train acc, avg train loss per class, avg train acc per class, avg test loss, avg test acc, avg test loss per class, avg test acc per class], [epoch 2...], [epoch 3...], [epoch 4...]]

*graphs* stores visualizations of the model's training journey generated by matplotlib
